1. Enter \(P2\) moving right and proceed to \(Q2\).
2. The wall between \(Q2\) and \(R2\) makes the robot turn downward into \(Q1\).
3. At the bottom, it turns left into \(P1\), then turns upward and travels through \(P2,P3,P4\).
4. At the top, it turns right and crosses row \(4\) to \(T4\).
5. At the right wall, it turns downward through \(T3,T2,T1\).
6. At the bottom, it turns left into \(S1\).
7. The wall between \(S1\) and \(R1\) makes it turn upward through \(S2,S3,S4\).
8. At the top, it turns right and returns to \(T4\).

At \(T4\), the robot is now in exactly the same position and direction as before, so this cycle repeats indefinitely. Every right turn is possible, so it never stops.
